The timer is a hardware device. The other three are traps caused by the running program.
It's a software-generated interrupt caused by a user request.
It's a trap (exception) caused by the running program's error.
The interrupt number is the index into the vector.
The interrupt handler is short. The rest of the time the CPU runs the user program while the disk transfers.
Everything the OS does is a response to an interrupt or trap.
